claimDefects.claim: assumptions.ts:7-8 says every runnable default lives there and no other module hard-codes a physical constant.
claimDefects.correction: At least the separately inventoried model choices define behavior outside Assumptions and are not overrideable or disclosed.
The names may be medium confidence, but values in volts, degrees, RPM, and percent depend on unproven equations and should be unknown/assumed.

claimDefects.claim: Selector records at 40aa/40ae/40b2/40b6 use provenance=spec even though the file says table contents are model-assigned.
claimDefects.correction: Track base provenance separately from slot-content provenance.
Binary analysis proves 150 entries at 0x45c0..0x46eb with terminator 0x46ec.
SAB80C515 binary vectors are ADC=0x0043 and external-2=0x004b.

claimDefects.claim: CRCL/CRCH and CC2/CC3 use the addresses in cleanroom memory-map.ts.
Ignition charge/fire is scheduled on CC2/CC3 and P1.2/P1.3.
claimDefects.correction: Binary hardware evidence maps ignition to Timer0/P1.5 and injector banks to CC2/P1.2 and CC3/P1.3.

claimDefects.claim: The KW71 session rejects complement mismatches.
claimDefects.correction: No path sets awaitingEcho=true, so the check is unreachable.

claimDefects.claim: The model implements memory/SFR range reads.
claimDefects.correction: The SFR branch now reads address+i; the former repeated-first-byte behavior remains recorded here.
